before any release was made.

This is in regards to Jeffrey Epstein, a main subject of the file above. Mr. Epstein has made three
Freedom of Information Act requests for his FBI file since 2010 and has appealed our latest denial in
December 2012 to Dors Office of Information Policy. As such I am required to verify that the case
remains pending. For RMD to be able to deny processing the file there must be potential prosecutive
action remaining, such as continuing appeals, rather than simply remaining pending awaiting
destruction of evidence.

Thanks,
